verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents a first-party MCP server endpoint (/api/app/public/v1/mcp, streamable HTTP) that any MCP client can connect to with just a URL and API key, positioning Foreloop as the tool-server side while agents like Claude Code/Codex act as clients. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP endpoint working, and no detail on the full tool schema exposed via MCP.
